use_case_lines.invoice: For GST invoice processing, a typical first step is a 2-week pilot on a sample of 200 bills with checksum, tax and duplicate checks before anything reaches the ERP.
use_case_lines.document: For policy and document Q&A, I usually start with a cited-answer assistant over 5-10 documents, with role-based access and an evaluation set.
use_case_lines.lead: For lead qualification, a transparent scorecard and consent-aware follow-up are usually the quickest wins.
use_case_lines.default: I usually start with a short discovery call to size the problem and agree on a measurable pilot.
